architecture: durable admission remains outside the main provider transcript until a sideband transition decision commits
forced strict transition_decision is the sideband model's only tool
transition response text is discarded and no assistant Conversation or surface is created
steer_current alone enters the active AgentLoop at its next safe model boundary
followup, new Work, and resume never enter the old AgentLoop and first appear as their own Run current request
cancel terminates the old Run and stops owned processes
ambiguous remains unresolved and is not applied to current Work
paused candidates are bounded visible-source summaries with runtime-owned opaque handles
